finding.title: sendfile/splice zero-copy calls
finding.message: Linux zero-copy file transfer calls. On SDP 8.0 build 141: splice, tee, vmsplice, copy_file_range and sendfile64 are not declared. sendfile() is declared in <sys/socket.h> with the BSD signature (7 arguments) but no SDP library exports it: linking fails (also with -lsocket). A same-named Linux call would not have compiled against that prototype anyway. [verified on SDP 8.0.0.00141T202311271501L by compile/link probe, not run on target: sendfile: declared (sys/socket.h:816 decl) but link fails with the default libraries, -lsocket and -lm: no SDP library exports it]
finding.remedy: Fall back to a read()/write() loop (or mmap + write) behind a small helper; add a platform fast path only if profiling demands it.
finding.verify: checked against the installed SDP (header, symbol and qcc probes); not executed on a QNX target.
